spine: 1. 官方立場先行：v1 不會消失，遷移是選擇題而非義務，所以比較的重點是升級那天輸出與輸入會怎麼變。
2. 輸入側從容忍改為拒絕：無效 UTF-8、重複名稱、大小寫比對、struct 結構錯誤，v2 預設都改成嚴格，代價是 v1 能過的輸入可能報錯。
3. 輸出側悄悄變形：nil slice 與 map 由 null 變 []，omitempty 改以 JSON 空值判準，time.Duration 預設報錯。
4. API 側：v1 的選項傳不進 Marshal 與自訂 marshaler，MarshalJSON 與 UnmarshalJSON 逼出額外配置與重複 parse，v2 以 Options 與 MarshalJSONTo 等串流方法補上。
5. 效能與相容：Marshal 持平，Unmarshal 最多 10 倍；v1 建在 v2 之上，故可用 Options 逐項還原並漸進遷移。
6. 遷移路線依風險容忍度分三條：一次全換、逐項選項、jsonsplit；jsonsplit 以約兩倍 marshal 成本換取不改變行為的差異偵測。
7. 決策規則：不動沒有壓力；要換時，輸入吃第三方資料或輸出有下游依賴者走較保守路線。

perspective.mechanism: v1 的缺陷（寬鬆輸入、API 無法傳選項、MarshalJSON 的額外配置與重複 parse）是現有 API 的內生後果；v2 用 Options、jsontext 與串流 marshaler 介面重做，v1 再建在 v2 之上。
perspective.tradeoff: 預設變嚴格換來安全與互通，但與 v1 不向後相容；效能 Marshal 持平，Unmarshal 最多 10 倍。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣的 Go 後端工程師用它判斷哪些 payload 與輸出契約會在升級日改變，並決定是否現在遷移。

perspective.mechanism: 所有分歧都由 Options 涵蓋，DefaultOptionsV1 一次還原，後面的選項覆寫前面的，故可逐項啟用 v2 行為；jsonsplit 同時呼叫 v1 與 v2 並回報差異。
perspective.tradeoff: jsonsplit 約加倍 marshal 成本，可抽樣緩解；輸出有差異不代表下游一定壞。
perspective.reader_use: 依服務複雜度與風險容忍度挑一次全換、逐項選項或 jsonsplit。

perspective.mechanism: v2 以嚴格區分大小寫比對成員名稱，未對應成員預設被忽略；omitzero 以 Go 型別系統定義，omitempty 以 JSON 型別系統定義。
perspective.tradeoff: 更安全的預設與較高的遷移成本並存。
perspective.reader_use: 查閱 tag 選項與安全考量，確認遷移後欄位是否仍被解入。

notes.quote: the new encoding/json/v2 and encoding/json/jsontext packages are stable and generally available in Go 1.27!
notes.interpretation: v2 與 jsontext 在 Go 1.27 進入穩定可用。

notes.quote: encoding/json currently accepts invalid UTF-8, whereas the latest Internet Standard (RFC 8259) requires valid UTF-8.
notes.interpretation: v1 接受無效 UTF-8，與 RFC 8259 要求不符。

notes.quote: The default behavior should err on the side of safety and reject duplicate names.
notes.interpretation: Go 團隊主張重複名稱預設應拒絕；同一來源另寫 v1 接受重複成員名稱。

notes.quote: indicated that most Go users prefer that nil slices and maps are marshaled as an empty JSON array or object by default.
notes.interpretation: nil slice 與 map 改為輸出空陣列與空物件，理由是多數使用者偏好；前文提到 v1 將其寫成 null。

notes.quote: This is a surprising default, a potential security vulnerability, and a performance limitation.
notes.interpretation: 針對 v1 不分大小寫的成員名稱比對；同段說明 v1 以不分大小寫方式把成員名稱對應到 struct 欄位。

notes.quote: v2 redefines the omitempty tag option to omit a field if it would have encoded as an “empty” JSON value
notes.interpretation: omitempty 改以編碼後是否為 JSON 空值判斷，空值為 null、空字串、[]、{}。

notes.quote: v2 reports an error when trying to serialize a time.Duration, which currently has no default representation
notes.interpretation: time.Duration 在 v2 預設序列化即報錯；v1 行為與還原選項來源未述。

notes.quote: The Marshal performance of v2 is roughly at parity with v1.
notes.interpretation: Marshal 效能大致持平。

notes.quote: with benchmarks demonstrating improvements of up to 10x.
notes.interpretation: Unmarshal 最多 10 倍，是上限不是平均；前文為 The Unmarshal performance of v2 is significantly faster than v1。

notes.quote: You can expect additional improvements in Go 1.28.
notes.interpretation: 預告 Go 1.28 有進一步改善，未給細節。

notes.quote: We’ve achieved this by designing the new packages such that, under the hood, v1 is implemented in terms of v2.
notes.interpretation: v1 建在 v2 之上，兩者可互通。

notes.quote: Implementing v1 in terms of v2 options has the additional benefit of allowing gradual migration of callsites.
notes.interpretation: 以選項實作 v1 使 callsite 可漸進遷移。

notes.quote: json.Marshal(..., json.DefaultOptionsV2(), jsontext.AllowDuplicateNames(true))
notes.interpretation: 部落格的範例：選取全部 v2 行為但允許重複名稱；選項直接跟在參數後。

notes.quote: Users often write json.NewDecoder(r).Decode(v), which fails to reject trailing junk at the end of the input.
notes.interpretation: v1 Decoder 常見用法不拒絕尾端多餘資料；v2 對應處理來源未述。

notes.quote: these problems are inherent consequences of the existing API, making them practically impossible to fix
notes.interpretation: 問題是現有 API 的內生後果，故另開 v2。

notes.quote: While it is relatively easy to add new features, it is difficult to change existing features.
notes.interpretation: 新增功能容易、改既有功能困難。

notes.quote: Go has included support for JSON in the standard library since well before Go 1.0.
notes.interpretation: 標準庫對 JSON 的支援早於 Go 1.0。

notes.quote: The v2 effort took about 6 years to reach this point
notes.interpretation: v2 花約六年。

notes.quote: first with a GopherCon talk and discussion posted in late 2023, formal proposal posted in early 2025,
notes.interpretation: 公開時程：2023 年底演講與討論、2025 年初正式提案。

notes.quote: and finally adopting encoding/json/v2 as a Go experiment in Go 1.25 for wider-scale testing by all Go users.
notes.interpretation: Go 1.25 以實驗功能釋出。

notes.quote: In late 2020, spurred on by the inability to fix issues in the current package,
notes.interpretation: 2020 年底開始原型。

notes.quote: Due to an implementation detail, MarshalJSON methods declared on a pointer receiver are inconsistently called by
notes.interpretation: v1 對 pointer receiver 的 MarshalJSON 呼叫不一致。

notes.quote: Options can be set on the Encoder and Decoder types, but cannot be used with the Marshal and Unmarshal functions.
notes.interpretation: v1 選項無法用於 Marshal 與 Unmarshal。

notes.quote: and there is no way to plumb options down the call stack.
notes.interpretation: Marshaler 與 Unmarshaler 型別拿不到選項。

notes.quote: The MarshalJSON interface method forces the implementation to allocate the returned []byte.
notes.interpretation: v1 MarshalJSON 逼實作配置 []byte。

notes.quote: This forces encoding/json to parse the JSON value to be unmarshaled in its entirety to determine where it ends
notes.interpretation: UnmarshalJSON 需完整值，先 parse 整個值找結尾。

notes.quote: Afterwards, the UnmarshalJSON method itself must parse the provided JSON value again.
notes.interpretation: UnmarshalJSON 內再 parse 一次。

notes.quote: In v2, we introduce the MarshalJSONTo and UnmarshalJSONFrom interface methods that operate on an Encoder or Decoder,
notes.interpretation: v2 新增作用在 Encoder 與 Decoder 的介面方法；是否省略配置來源未量化。

notes.quote: The MarshalWrite and UnmarshalRead functions directly operate on an io.Writer or io.Reader,
notes.interpretation: v2 提供直接作用在 Writer 與 Reader 的函式；MarshalEncode 與 UnmarshalDecode 作用在 jsontext 型別。

notes.quote: Since it only interacts with JSON at a syntactic level, it does not depend on Go reflection.
notes.interpretation: jsontext 只處理語法，不依賴 reflection。

notes.quote: No problem, v2 supports MarshalJSON methods, so marshaling will continue working as expected.
notes.interpretation: 既有 MarshalJSON 方法在 v2 繼續可用。

notes.quote: First things first: you don’t have to!
notes.interpretation: 遷移指南開頭先說不必遷移。

notes.quote: The encoding/json package will never go away.
notes.interpretation: v1 不會消失。

notes.quote: But they are not backwards compatible; some applications may depend on the v1 behavior.
notes.interpretation: v2 的嚴格預設不向後相容；前文為 the v2 package chooses stricter, more interoperable defaults than v1。

notes.quote: Marshalers allows overriding the marshal behavior of specific types, even if you do not control those types.
notes.interpretation: v2 Marshalers 可覆寫特定型別的 marshal 行為，含第三方型別。

notes.quote: In v1, bytes of invalid UTF-8 within a string are silently replaced with the Unicode replacement character.
notes.interpretation: v1 靜默替換無效 UTF-8；v2 同段寫 results in an error。

notes.quote: In v1, a JSON object with duplicate names is permitted.
notes.interpretation: v1 允許重複名稱；v2 報錯。

notes.quote: In v1, a nil Go slice or Go map is marshaled as a JSON null.
notes.interpretation: v1 nil slice 與 map 為 null；v2 為空陣列或空物件。

notes.quote: In v1, errors are never reported at runtime for Go struct types that have some form of structural error
notes.interpretation: v1 不對 struct 結構錯誤報執行期錯誤。

notes.quote: In contrast, v2 reports a runtime error for Go types that are invalid as they relate to JSON serialization.
notes.interpretation: v2 對此類型別報執行期錯誤。

notes.quote: applying the “string” JSON struct field tag to an invalid type (such as a struct) is ignored in v1
notes.interpretation: string tag 套在不合法型別上，v1 忽略、v2 報錯。

notes.quote: While ReportErrorsWithLegacySemantics would suppress the error, it makes more sense to drop the “string” tag.
notes.interpretation: 指南建議拿掉無作用的 string tag，而非壓掉錯誤。

notes.quote: The difficult part of migrating from v1 to v2 is not the API differences, but behavior changes
notes.interpretation: 遷移難點在行為變動。

notes.quote: Notice that the “Nicknames” field for Remi has changed from null to [].
notes.interpretation: Pet 範例：Nicknames 由 null 變 []；同段另寫 so this change may break them。

notes.quote: All of the places where v2 behavior diverges from v1 are covered by Options
notes.interpretation: 所有分歧都有對應 Options；DefaultOptionsV1 還原全部 v1 行為。

notes.quote: Later options override earlier options, so you can use this list to enable v2 behaviors one at a time.
notes.interpretation: 選項後者覆寫前者，可逐項啟用 v2 行為。

notes.quote: Simply update callsites to use encoding/json/v2, make sure the tests pass, and check it in.
notes.interpretation: 一次全換路線的步驟。

notes.quote: As a first step, migrate all calls to encoding/json/v2 with DefaultOptionsV1. This is a trivial and safe change.
notes.interpretation: 逐項選項路線的第一步。

notes.quote: If the application is complex or has a low risk tolerance, then you may need to take a slower, more careful approach.
notes.interpretation: 複雜或低風險容忍的應用需要較慢較謹慎的路線。

notes.quote: It will report any differences, but still return the v1 value to the caller.
notes.interpretation: CallBothButReturnV1 的行為。

notes.quote: This allows a production service to report differences without changing its behavior.
notes.interpretation: jsonsplit 讓正式服務回報差異而不改變行為。

notes.quote: jsonsplit will even automatically determine which specific options cause the difference
notes.interpretation: jsonsplit 可自動判斷造成差異的選項。

notes.quote: Marshaling with both v1 and v2 to detect differences will approximately double the cost of marshaling
notes.interpretation: jsonsplit 約加倍 marshal 成本。

notes.quote: To mitigate these costs, jsonsplit allows checking only a random subset of calls
notes.interpretation: 可抽樣緩解成本。

notes.quote: Note that a difference in output does not necessarily mean that downstream behavior is broken
notes.interpretation: 輸出差異不一定代表下游壞掉，只是有壞的機會。

notes.quote: Where jsonsplit reports differences, adjust the options or types to ensure identical output.
notes.interpretation: jsonsplit 第三步。

notes.quote: (which are null, "", [], and {}).
notes.interpretation: 部落格列出 omitempty 的 empty 值：null、空字串、[]、{}（接在 n06 之後）。

notes.quote: For more benchmark details, see the go-json-experiment/jsonbench repository.
notes.interpretation: 部落格附 benchmark 專案 go-json-experiment/jsonbench 的連結。

notes.quote: The v2 API generally chooses more secure defaults than v1.
notes.interpretation: v2 一般而言選擇更安全的預設。

notes.quote: v2 uses a (strict) case-sensitive match on the name.
notes.interpretation: v2 嚴格區分大小寫。

notes.quote: Object members that do not match any struct fields, also known as “unknown members”, are ignored by default
notes.interpretation: 未對應任何欄位的成員預設被忽略。

notes.quote: The former is defined in terms of the Go type system, while the latter in terms of the JSON type system.
notes.interpretation: omitzero 以 Go 型別系統、omitempty 以 JSON 型別系統定義。
